#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Flux job script translated from LSF

#flux: --job-name=RNAseq
#flux: -q rna

# The LSF output/error directives are combined into a single output file.
# The '%J' variable is replaced with Flux's '{job.id}'.
#flux: -o logs/snakemake_{job.id}.out

# This master script itself only needs minimal resources.
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -t 24:00:00 # Defaulting to 24 hours, as none was specified.

# CRITICAL: The LSF memory request for the master job ('rusage[mem=4]') was not translated.
# Flux does not have a standard equivalent directive. The job will receive the default memory allocation.
# #BSUB -R "select[mem>4] rusage[mem=4]"


set -o nounset -o pipefail -o errexit -x

# Create log directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p logs

# Load modules
module load singularity/3.9.2

# WARNING: The '--drmaa' arguments have been translated from LSF to Flux.
# This requires a correctly configured Snakemake DRMAA profile for Flux.
# CRITICAL: LSF's memory request ('-R "{params.memory} ..."') has no standard Flux equivalent and has been OMITTED.
# All sub-jobs will get default memory, which will likely cause many of them to fail.
args=' \
  -q rna \
  -o {log}.out \
  -J {params.job_name} \
  -c {threads} ' 

# Run snakemake pipeline
snakemake \
    --drmaa "$args" \
    --snakefile Snakefile \
    --configfile config.yaml \
    --jobs 12 \
    --latency-wait 60 \
    --rerun-incomplete \
    --use-singularity \
    --singularity-args "--bind /beevol/home/rbilab --bind /beevol/home/wellskri --bind /beevol/home/wellskri/packages/bin --bind /tmp:/tmp"

issues: CRITICAL: As noted in the script's comments, the LSF memory request (`-R "rusage[mem=...]"`) for both the master job and, more importantly, for the sub-jobs submitted via `--drmaa` has been omitted. This means all jobs submitted by this workflow will receive the system's default memory allocation, which is highly likely to be insufficient and cause many of the workflow's steps to fail.

The script relies on a Snakemake DRMAA profile being correctly configured for Flux. If this profile is not set up, or if the `snakemake` command cannot find the necessary DRMAA library, the job will fail to submit any sub-jobs.
